$comment: FAQ entries, grouped by `category` (shown in this order). Answers are plain text; blank lines are not supported, keep each answer to one paragraph.

items.question: Where do I buy tickets?
items.answer: Tickets are sold through the venue. Use the Get Tickets button on any event or film page. Ticket links will go live when the lineup is announced.

items.question: How much are tickets?
items.answer: Prices will be announced with the lineup.

items.question: Can I get a refund or exchange?
items.answer: Refunds and exchanges follow the venue's ticketing policy. Contact the venue box office directly for help with an existing booking.

items.question: Where is the festival held?
items.answer: Most sessions are held at ACMI, Federation Square, Melbourne. Each event page lists its exact venue.

items.question: Is the venue accessible?
items.answer: Contact us before the event if you have specific access needs and we'll do our best to help.

items.question: When should I arrive?
items.answer: Please arrive a little before your screening starts. Late entry may not be possible once a film has started.

items.question: Are the films subtitled?
items.answer: Yes. Every film screens in its original language with English subtitles.

items.question: Are there age restrictions?
items.answer: Each film shows its Australian classification. Films marked CTC (Check the Classification) have not been classified yet; check the film page closer to the date.

items.question: Can schools attend the Educational Screening?
items.answer: Yes. The Educational Screening is designed for students and young audiences. Email us to ask about bringing a school or group.

items.question: How do I submit a film to the Short Film Competition?
items.answer: Submission details for the 21st edition will be announced on the Short Film Competition page and our socials.

items.question: How can my organisation sponsor the festival?
items.answer: Visit the Sponsors page or email us. We offer packages for businesses, community groups and institutions of every size.
